page.layout: One printed page, one text column of full lines with centred short lines at the end; below the text a woodcut ornament (flower vase), no marginal notes; catchword at the foot right "A MON-".

main_text.p: Patriarchæ, Job, Moses, David, Prophetæ & Apostoli & alii, omnes perseverantiæ donô insignes fuerint, & tamen nullus eorum pietati renuncia vit aut inimicus fuit; Si hæc doctrina de Perseverantia trahitur ad lasciviam carnis, teste Juda v. 4. fit hoc per accidens; Hæc autem præcipua illorum hypothesis, quâ docent certitudinem perseverantiæ stare non posse cum mediis hortationis, promissionum, comminationum ex parte Dei, nec cum conditionibus vigilantiæ, obedientiæ, precum ex parte nostra, eos fallit & falluntur ex oppositione subordinatorum, nam finis infallibilitas & certitudo non tollit, sed stabilit usum mediorum, & Sancti, qui per fidem norunt certam esse perseverantiam, simul norunt absque sanctitate, fugâ peccati, ac studio pietatis se eam assequi non posse, ideoque hæc petunt à Deo, & impetrant quoque, & sic per gratiam ipsius perseverant: Illustratura simili, tum exemplis, Hiskiæ, Esa.38. 5. 21. cui promissa vitæ prolongatio, & tamen adhibitum emplastrum, tum Pauli Act. 27. 24. 31. qui certus erat ex revelatione neminem periturum ex iis, qui in navi erant, & tamen de nautis ait, si illi discesserint, reliquos servari non posse.

page.notes: Woodcut ornament (flower vase) below the text, not transcribed. The catchword "A MON-" is printed at the lower right. Some words are set in italic (names of Scripture figures and "Prophetæ & Apostoli"). Certain words in the printed text are uncertain, such as "Illustratura" which reads as "Illustratura" with a macron-like mark; the printed line was "Illustratura" as read.
